builder_log.text:
BUILD INTENT: THE TOWER — the counter-hypothesis

OPERATION: If the buildable shelf is small, vertical growth is cheaper than long foundations. One 18 ft square, four levels, one stair, one stack. The foundation is the smallest thing on the site.

REFERENCE IT COMES FROM: The 18 × 18 House — "do not assume the contour bar wins"

DO NOT COPY: Nothing formal. This scheme exists to falsify the long bar, and it earns its place only if the numbers say so.
THE TEST THIS SCHEME MUST PASS: Put it beside the bar and compare foundation length, perimeter per square foot, and earthwork. If it wins, the bar was a habit.
Plan authored and machine-checked. 4 levels, 25 rooms accepted by tools/build-plans.mjs; 10 flags raised.
Built in 3D from that plan by tools/render/lib/build3d.mjs and rendered. 27 parts. 1,296 sf conditioned, 72 lf perimeter, 18 lf wet wall, 59 CY cut.
